title: How to check a client's overlap
objectives: Run the four checking steps, starting from the CAS.
Look beyond fund pairs at the combined portfolio and direct holdings.
body_md:
How to check: list every equity fund the client holds, across all platforms and AMCs (the CAS helps). Run the main pairs through an overlap tool, starting with the largest holdings. Also look at the combined portfolio: top 10 stocks, sector weights and market-cap split. Check whether the client also holds the same stocks directly, through ESOPs or a PMS.

> **Investor takeaway:** Start every overlap check from the CAS: it shows funds across all AMCs.
example: CAS shows 9 equity funds across 4 AMCs: run the largest pairs first, then look at the combined top 10 stocks.
say: List every fund across all platforms and AMCs.
Check direct holdings too: ESOPs and PMS stocks count.
never: Check only funds from one AMC.
